message.content: They believed that trade gave the pharaohs immense power. The rulers used those goods to strengthen their empires. We know that they controlled the routes carefully. Their subjects served them with loyalty. He often demanded tribute from distant lands. She, the queen, also managed some diplomatic exchanges. It was clear that these interactions boosted their status. You can see this in many ancient texts. They exchanged gold for exotic spices. That wealth funded their grand monuments. We should not ignore the cultural exchange either. He sent envoys to neighboring kingdoms. She reported back on foreign customs. It helped them understand their rivals better. You might wonder why it mattered so much. They needed resources for their building projects. Those materials came from afar. We rely on archaeology to learn more. He displayed his trophies proudly. She adorned her temples with imported gems. It showed their global reach. You cannot underestimate their influence.
